title: Django 4.2.10 release notes | Django documentation | Django
content:
Django 4.2.10 fixes a security issue with severity “moderate” in 4.2.9.

The intcomma template filter was subject to a potential denial-of-service attack when used with very long strings.

headings.text: CVE-2024-24680: Potential denial-of-service in intcomma template filter¶
